title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #007 · 교복 · 보딩스쿨 니트 × 돌핀 쇼츠(옆 슬릿) · 플랫 메리제인 플랫+레이스 발목 양말 · powerlifter bombshell · 손허리·턱 · 배경 바닷가 산책로 · 브리티시 모드
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, waist-length braids chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro boarding-school set, a cropped sleeveless V-neck vest of ultra-thin matte cream fine rib knit with navy and gold stripes along the V and the hem, a small white collar and a slim striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the rib knit fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and micro dolphin gym shorts of ultra-thin matte forest-green rib knit with high-cut side slits rising to her hip bones and a thin contrasting stripe down each side, sitting at the top of her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin rib knit molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the navy and gold stripes on the vest and the clean edges of the dolphin shorts and their side stripes, a fine ribbed knit texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: black patent Mary Jane flat shoes with a thin ankle strap and a small silver buckle, worn with white lace-trim ankle socks, her feet planted flat on the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in cream lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
